paragraphs: I lead the structuring and evolution of the group's IT department, driving end-to-end digitization of critical processes and the deployment of Artificial Intelligence as a lever for productivity, cost reduction and data-driven decision making.

Alongside mentoring sessions with managers and teams, consolidating systems and centralizing processes and data delivered an estimated reduction of R$ 125 thousand per year in software licenses, together with the digitization of many of the company's workflows.
As an Engineering Process Analyst on the Industry 4.0 team, I took part in the development of several projects focused on centralizing production data from the company's machines and departments.

The solutions integrated information from 48 production lines across four factories — Bluffton (United States), Belém/PA, and two plants in Linhares/ES (Brazil) — making operational data available in real time to factory management, administrative teams, branches, and headquarters, with rollout underway to Argentina, Algeria, and China.

This centralization eliminated manual steps and ended managers' wait for end-of-day data closing before reporting to headquarters. With centralized, periodic numbers, teams began estimating productivity gains, adjusting targets, and anticipating maintenance — estimated gains of approximately R$ 300 thousand per year, combining process reduction, production accuracy, data centralization, and lower maintenance costs.
highlights: Expanding to Argentina, Algeria and China

paragraphs: I began my journey on the Industry 4.0 team taking part in shop-floor digitization projects. I contributed to the development of applications, automations, and dashboards responsible for collecting, organizing, and visualizing machine production data.
These solutions began to replace decentralized controls and manual processes, giving teams a more reliable and up-to-date view of the industrial operation.

While working across the Technology and Logistics areas, I developed an application to analyze and forecast the company's freight costs. The solution automatically compared carriers' price tables and factored in variables such as destination, weight, volume, cargo type, additional fees, and commercial conditions.

With this information, the team could identify the carrier offering the best cost-benefit for each operation before contracting the freight, increasing the accuracy of logistics decisions and reducing expenses.
Over nine months of use, the solution contributed to savings of more than R$ 1.2 million in the company's transportation costs.
